data.title: Arknights: Endfield Game Tools Updated for the New Version!
data.brief: Game Tools Update: Progression Calculator Is Live; Complete the Limited-Time Sign-In to Get Oroberyl
data.data:
Game Tools Update: Progression Calculator Is Live; Complete the Limited-Time Sign-In to Get Oroberyls


Dear Endministrators,

Arknights: Endfield Game Tools have been updated during the [Homecoming] version. Check out what's been changed!


Progression Calculator is now available! Try it now!

Open the SKPORT app, then go to the Arknights: Endfield section. Tap the [Progression Calculator] icon at the top to access it.

- You can select operators and weapons, set target progression levels, and see an overview of all the materials needed to progress them.、

- Select up to 8 operators to add to your plan and see their combined material requirements.

- You can choose whether to sync your Depot resources to compare the resources required for progression against your current inventory and see what you're still missing, helping you plan future upgrades more effectively.


>>Go to the Progression Calculator<<


Daily Sign-In Tool Update: Limited-Time Sign-In Event Is Now Live!

Sign in daily to get various in-game items. Complete the 7-day sign-in to earn a total of Oroberyl×260!

Limited-Time Sign-In Event Period: July 17 – July 31 at 23:59 (UTC+8). Don't miss out!


>>Go to Sign In<<


Map Tools Update: New Version Area Maps and Related Markers Added!

Added the [Wuling - Yinglung Pass] and [Wuling - North Wuling Exclusion Zone] area maps and related markers.

Use the Real-Time Location Sync feature to easily explore the new areas and quickly locate Aurylenes and storage crates!


>>Go to Map Tools<<


Team Picks & Build Guide Update: New Operator [Arcane] Now Available!

The [Team Picks] and [Build Guide] tool pages have been updated with the new operator [Arcane]! You can easily browse recommended team comps and build strategies shared by other Endmins, or submit your own team comps and build plans to share unique insights with fellow players.


>>Go to Team Picks & Build Guide<<


WIKI Update: New Version Character, Weapon, Items, Facilities and More

With the latest version update, WIKI will feature entries for the new operator [Arcane], new weapon [Type 42: Solemn Phalanx], and other newly added items, facilities, and gear.


>>Go to WIKI<<


More tool updates will be rolled out in this current version. Stay tuned!

That covers all the tool updates for this new version! We hope these enhancements provide even more support for your journey, Endministrators.

We welcome all Endministrators to use our Game Tools and provide valuable feedback. We will continue to improve the functionality and user experience of each tool. Thank you for your continued support!
